topic: XRP ETF holdings universe reconciliation, estimated fund cost basis, Q2 institutional 13F ownership and Goldman Sachs indirect Evernorth transaction exposure

claims.claim: CryptoETF.today's XRP page published 2026-11-03 05:47 UTC for the 2026-11-02 T+1 session reports 2 of 5 spot ETFs. The two reporting funds (Bitwise XRP and 21Shares TOXR) each report zero net creations/redemptions; XRPZ, XRPC and GXRP are explicitly missing. The displayed zero is partial, not a final five-fund daily total.
limitations: T+1 aggregator observation, not a final five-fund daily total
The page's five-fund universe excludes XRPR and BITW
AUM, cumulative flow, YTD flow and daily flow are different measures

claims.claim: XRP Insights reports 1,196,600,186 XRP held on 2026-10-30 across six US spot XRP ETFs plus BITW's XRP sleeve. Its seven-product universe includes XRPR and BITW in addition to the five products in CryptoETF.today's five-fund universe.
limitations: XRPR includes some exposure through another XRP ETP, creating look-through duplication risk if combined with the underlying ETP
BITW is a multi-asset index fund; its XRP sleeve changes with index rebalancing
The holdings snapshot is dated October 30, not November 2

claims.claim: The approximately 54.34M XRP difference between the two headline holdings totals is almost entirely explained by the two products present in XRP Insights but absent from CryptoETF.today's five-fund universe. Adding XRP Insights' October 30 XRPR and BITW quantities to CryptoETF.today's November 2 five-fund holdings gives 1,196,508,841 XRP, only 91,345 XRP (about 0.0076%) below XRP Insights' October 30 seven-product total. Because the two five-fund observations have different dates, the 91,345 XRP residual is not an error finding and is not attributed to a specific fund.
claims.disconfirming_test: Recompute using same-date issuer-reported holdings for all seven products. Until then, preserve the near-reconciliation as cross-date arithmetic, not an exact reconciliation.

claims.claim: CryptoETF.today estimates a five-fund average entry of approximately $1.72 and unrealized aggregate loss of approximately $476.7M at the November 2 XRP close around $1.25. XRP Insights estimates a seven-product average break-even of $1.7092, with approximately 1.20B XRP and $2.05B estimated cost, about $550M below cost at the October 30 reference price around $1.25.
limitations: Both are provider-calculated estimates, not issuer-reported fund accounting or individual investor cost bases
XRP Insights uses an average-cost method and its own holdings/price reconstruction
An underwater estimated fund cost basis does not establish future redemptions or selling pressure

claims.claim: CryptoETF.today's institutional-holder section reports 127 institutions with approximately $179M in XRP ETF positions across five funds as of 2026-06-30. It reports Goldman Sachs at $86.5M, Jane Street $16.4M, Millennium Management $16.2M, Intesa Sanpaolo $14.4M and Marex $8.1M. The provider classifies some positions as banks/brokers and market makers; those classifications and aggregate holder count remain provider-derived.
limitations: 13F is a quarter-end snapshot, not current holdings
13F does not show the holder's full hedge book, short exposure, futures or all client relationships
Positions may reflect market making, basis trading, facilitation or other non-directional activity

claims.claim: Goldman Sachs Group Inc's SEC Form 13F-HR filed 2026-08-14 for the 2026-06-30 report date lists five XRP ETF positions totaling $86,506,129 and 7,390,191 shares.
limitations: 13F reports reportable long securities positions at quarter end; it does not prove beneficial economic direction after hedges
The filing does not disclose why the positions were held
It does not establish that Goldman purchased or custodies the underlying XRP

claims.claim: The same Goldman Sachs Q2 2026 Form 13F lists 365,976 shares of Armada Acquisition Corp II valued at $3,813,470. Evernorth's SEC filing identifies Armada, Evernorth, Pathfinder and Ripple as parties to the proposed business combination. This is a disclosed Goldman equity position in the SPAC involved in the Evernorth transaction, not direct XRP ownership and not direct ownership of Evernorth XRP.
claims.source_location: Goldman information-table row 1065; Evernorth SEC filing, organization and business-combination agreement note
claims.interpretation: Indirect transaction exposure through the SPAC equity; motive and hedging are unknown.

claims.claim: Goldman's SEC-verified $86.506M XRP ETF position equals approximately 48.3% of CryptoETF.today's provider-reported $179M aggregate 13F value across the five funds. This is a concentration statistic within that provider's reported institutional sample, not 48.3% ownership of ETF shares or XRP supply.

The latest Goldman filing verified in this capture is its Q2 2026 13F-HR filed August 14 for June 30. The institutional-holder tracker says its next Q3 update is after November 14, 2026. Q2 positions must not be represented as current November holdings.
claims.treatment: Set position_available_at to filing acceptance time (2026-08-14T17:15:03Z), while preserving report_date 2026-06-30. Do not backdate knowledge to quarter end in a point-in-time model.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The apparent ~54.4M XRP difference between aggregator holdings totals is primarily a product-universe difference, not a missing-reserve discrepancy.
supporting_evidence: XRP Insights includes XRPR and BITW while CryptoETF.today's five-fund page does not
Adding XRPR and BITW's October 30 holdings to CryptoETF's November 2 five-fund total leaves only a 91,345 XRP cross-date residual
disconfirming_evidence: The observations are not same-date; exact reconciliation remains unproven
competing_hypotheses.test: Fetch same-date issuer-reported XRP holdings for all seven products and recompute the five-common-fund subset.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Estimated ETF acquisition cost above spot may create redemption sensitivity if XRP remains below the fund-complex average cost.
supporting_evidence: Two aggregators estimate average fund-level acquisition prices around $1.71-$1.72 while spot was around $1.25
disconfirming_evidence: The estimates are not issuer accounting or individual investor lots
The five-fund provider reports +$140.2M net flow over 30 trading days and +$648.4M YTD
Investors can maintain exposure while underwater; market makers may hedge elsewhere
competing_hypotheses.test: Measure subsequent share creations/redemptions and XRP holdings changes conditional on price-to-estimated-cost-basis gap, controlling for volatility, BTC returns and market-wide ETF flows.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Q2 13F positions demonstrate institutional access and participation in XRP-linked listed products.
supporting_evidence: 127 institutions and $179M reported across five funds by the tracker
Goldman's $86.506M across five XRP ETFs is directly verified in its SEC filing
disconfirming_evidence: 13F omits short positions, futures, many hedges and client-level intent
Goldman could be market making, arbitrage, facilitation or directional; motive is undisclosed
The position is dated June 30 and filed August 14
competing_hypotheses.test: Compare Q3 13F filings after November 14, fund share creations, AP/market-maker disclosures where public, and any corresponding futures/options positions disclosed elsewhere.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Goldman's Armada shares create an additional indirect financial connection to the Evernorth transaction alongside its XRP ETF holdings.
supporting_evidence: Evernorth's SEC filing identifies Armada as a party to the proposed business combination and Ripple as a party
disconfirming_evidence: Armada is a SPAC; the 13F does not disclose investment motive, hedges or current holding
The $3.813M SPAC position is much smaller than the $86.506M ETF positions
This does not establish direct Evernorth ownership or direct XRP purchases
competing_hypotheses.test: Track subsequent 13F changes, transaction closing filings, share conversions and any post-combination XRPN position.

feature_store_rules: Keep CryptoETF's five-spot-fund universe separate from XRP Insights' six-spot-plus-BITW seven-product universe.
Store each product's XRP holdings, AUM, daily flow, cumulative flow and trading volume as separate measures.
Missing fund rows are null/incomplete, never zero.
Store publication/retrieval time separately from underlying trading date and issuer holdings date.
Store estimated cost basis with provider, universe, method, price source and limitations; never label it investor cost basis.
Store 13F report_date and filing acceptance timestamp separately; model information availability no earlier than the filing timestamp.
Treat 13F positions as reportable listed-security exposure, not direct XRP holdings or unhedged directional conviction.
Store Goldman Armada/SPAC equity exposure separately from its XRP ETF positions; do not convert SPAC shares into XRP exposure.
Do not use Q2 13F positions as current Q4 holdings.
No forecast feature is promoted until point-in-time availability, revision policy and out-of-sample usefulness are tested.

forecast.reason: These observations improve ownership and supply accounting but do not establish a calibrated directional edge.

next_actions: Reconcile same-date issuer holdings across the five common funds plus XRPR and BITW.
Wait for the complete November 2 five-fund flow before treating the daily total as final.
Capture Q3 13F filings after November 14, 2026; compare Goldman, Jane Street, Millennium, Intesa and market-maker positions with Q2.
Track Armada-to-Evernorth transaction completion and any conversion of SPAC holdings into XRPN.
Test whether price-to-estimated-fund-cost-basis predicts subsequent redemptions; retain it as descriptive until walk-forward evidence exists.
Keep Coinbase execution depth, ETF ownership, ETF flows and institutional 13F holdings as distinct capital/liquidity layers.
safety: Research-only. No forecast, paper position, real-money transaction, merge, force-push, workflow dispatch, secret access or deployment.
